svg.aria-label: Sundermark realm dossier: what Valen is told and what it may do
svg.title: Sundermark realm dossier: what Valen is told and what it may do
svg.text: Margravine Isolde · proud, militarist, keeps her word to the letter
• Autumn Y1 — orm broke its pact with valen.
• Summer Y2 — aster sent valen 20 gold.
• Winter Y2 — orm refused valen’s offer of peace.
What valen is told this season
- At war with orm. At peace with aster, kharsa, thornwood.
- orm holds saltmere beside high_barrow, with 3 armies.
- old_crown is unclaimed, held by 3 pretender armies.
- Long memory: orm broke its pact with you in autumn of year 1.
- Renown: orm 11, valen 9, aster 7, kharsa 6, thornwood 4.
offered actions go in the schema; masked ones are absent, not forbidden in prose
